description: Mark a learning unit as completed after the user achieves a passing score (≥50%). Awards XP, unlocks the next unit, and checks for course completion. Called automatically by learning widgets (quiz, flashcards, etc.) when the user finishes. FREE call - no coin cost.

course_id.description: The course ID containing this unit (required)

learning_type.description: Type of learning activity completed (mcq, flashcard, fill_blank, match_pair, ranking, crossword, podcast, infographic)

score.description: The user's score (0-100). Must be ≥50 to complete the unit.

name: complete_unit
title: Complete Learning Unit
